title: Setup
text: Set up baseboard serial communications, {Parity} sets Select serial port parity; {Serial port} sets the port that is being accessed Legacy Serial, {Baud rate} selects serial port baud rate, {Number of data bits} selects serial port data bits, {Number of stop bits} selects serial port stop bits and {Enable auto RTX/CTS} selects serial port RTX/CTS mode. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Serial port
params.values: Port that is being accessed Legacy Serial Port 1 (default) |.. | Legacy Serial Port 8 | USB Serial Port 1 |.. | USB Serial Port 8

params.name: Parity
params.values: Select serial port parity None (default) | Even | Odd | Mark | Space

params.name: Enable auto RTX/CTS
params.values: Select serial port RTX/CTS mode off (default) | on
